mapper.select: SELECT ur.id, ur.user_id AS userId, ur.role_id AS roleId, r.name AS roleName, r.description AS roleDescription, r.status AS roleStatus, ur.create_time AS createTime, ur.update_time AS updateTime FROM pe_user_role ur JOIN pe_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ur.create_time DESC
